articles.title: ECB defends digital euro privacy as CBDCs face global scrutiny
articles.snippet: Piero Cipollone said the Eurosystem would not identify digital euro users as central bank digital currencies face privacy concerns worldwide.

articles.title: Banks, regulators join quantum-resistant crypto transfer pilot
articles.snippet: Participating banks will test post-quantum wallets and onchain transfers while regulators from Abu Dhabi, Bhutan and Malta initially observe.

articles.title: Digital Asset, Paul Ryan foundation target US state benefits with Canton pilot
articles.snippet: The RISE program would use the Canton Network to combine and distribute state-administered benefits across three US states beginning in 2027.

articles.title: Bitcoin Is Pumping But Prediction Market Traders Aren't Convinced
articles.snippet: Bitcoin's sharpest rally in five months flipped prediction-market odds from bearish to a coin flip—but the longer-term bets still price in a crash.

articles.title: Banking Regulator Races to Finalize GENIUS Act Stablecoin Rules
articles.snippet: OCC Comptroller Jonathan Gould told the Wyoming Blockchain Symposium the agency is moving at a rapid pace to beat a January statutory deadline, after already missing an earlier July target.
